_doc: Rules of the C# extractor (keys: see ts_generic.rules_of). public/protected = public (the API of library mode), internal = package, private/file = private; no modifier: a member is private, a type internal, an interface member public. virtual = dispatch (flag abstract: base.m reaches the overrides, link.py). A live member keeps its class alive (langs.json owner_edge). protocol: a public instance field or property of a class is a data member (serializer, model binder, EF, options binding read it by name, no call shows it) and so are the members the language or a host calls by convention (GetEnumerator, Dispose, Configure, OnGet*); both are alive with their class. An attribute other than a compiler or tooling one on a property or a field says a framework reads it by reflection (SerializeField, Inject, Column): flag protocol too. An attribute that makes a host build or call a type or member without a reference (MEF Export, WCF ServiceContract/DataContract, XML/JSON converters, COM, Unity editor and menu hooks, EF Table/Owned, view components) roots it: annotation.host-attr. strip_angles: the type arguments of a generic call are no part of the name (`repo.Get<Foo>(1)` is `repo.Get`). A member of an unnamed receiver (`new B().Run()`, `x?.Run()`, `a.F().G`, an object initializer `new Foo { Id = 1 }`) is the ref `?.Run`: link.py resolves it to every member of that name, and a bare name written in a member is a member of its type, its other (partial) parts and its bases (langs.json type_scope). A class derived at any depth from a host class or interface of this project (`Base : ControllerBase`, `Orders : Base`; Unity `Enemy : Character : MonoBehaviour`) is rooted by link.py (langs.json root_inherit), and so are all parts of a partial class; the host base list itself is matched by annotation.dotnet-host (the suffixes Controller, Hub ... are in the regex). Gaps: a type or member named by a computed string is not seen (a string literal given to GetMethod, GetType, CreateInstance ... is: dyn.name).
